system.description:
Teamwork. Once per turn, when an allied creature provides you a boost to a roll you make, cleanse you of a condition, restores your hit points or chakra point, or uses an effect that provides you advantage or any other form of assistance in combat, you gain 2 Drive. Other supportive effects can trigger this at GM’s discretion such as them interposing an attack or interrupting a harmful jutsu.

Mobility. Once per turn, when you transition to using a form of special movement such as Wall or Water Walking, Swimming, Climbing or Burrowing, before making an attack or casting a jutsu on the same turn, you gain 1 Drive.
